method: Balanced controlled comparison: 64 question-free boards and 64 boards with a synthetic 10% question frequency. Equal initial hands, visibility and per-step random seeds. Both policies play the unmodified reference simulator. Reference uses public Normal/Smart/Save upgrades settings; our unknown question outcomes use an independent equal-weight local-game effect prior.

qualityGate.scope: This balanced synthetic generator only; not server-layout or live application parity.

individualQualityGate.scope: Only this controlled generator and reference settings; not live-game or server-layout parity.

limitations: Artificial tile mixtures and question frequency; real server layouts and frequencies are not known.
Question effects are independently modelled from local game data; their server probabilities are not calibrated.
Special server layouts and live reader/application quality are not compared.
Finite Monte Carlo and approximate confidence intervals; no guarantee of a better move or real profit.
Concurrent process shards: use the separate performance report for isolated latency.
